mapper.sql: flt03_account_id AS account_id, flt03_company_id AS company_id, flt03_person_id AS person_id, TO_CHAR(flt03_setup_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS setup_date, flt03_reg_reason AS reg_reason, f_cdnm('AccountRegReason', flt03_reg_reason, flt03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS reg_reason_name, flt03_family_relate_cd AS family_relate_code, f_cdnm('FamilyRelateCode', flt03_family_relate_cd, flt03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS family_relate_name, CASE flt03_main_account_yn WHEN 'true' THEN TRUE WHEN 'false' THEN FALSE END AS main_account_yn, flt03_account_nm AS account_name, TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) AS account_no_dec, flt03_corp_id AS corp_id, sys15_corp_nm AS corp_name, flt03_corp_branch_nm AS corp_branch_name, flt03_item_type AS item_type, f_get_itemtype_nm(flt03_item_type, flt03_company_id) AS item_type_name, flt03_note AS note, flt03_appr_id AS appr_id, TO_CHAR(apr01_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS appr_reg_date, apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM flt10_tr WHERE flt10_account_id = flt03_account_id) AS tr_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM flt11_book WHERE flt11_account_id = flt03_account_id) AS book_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM flt13_book_init WHERE flt13_account_id = flt03_account_id) AS book_init_cnt
FROM flt03_account LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id AND sys15_company_id = flt03_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON flt03_appr_id = apr01_appr_id
mapper.select:
SELECT flt03_account_id AS account_id, emp00_org_code_nm AS org_name, emp00_kor_nm AS person_name, sys15_corp_nm AS corp_name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(flt06_close_date, DATE '9999-12-31') < CAST(#{setupDate} AS date) THEN '(폐쇄) ' ELSE '' END || TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) AS account_no_dec, flt03_account_nm AS account_name, f_cdnm('FamilyRelateCode', flt03_family_relate_cd, flt03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS family_relate_name, f_get_itemtype_nm(flt03_item_type, flt03_company_id) AS item_type_name, TO_CHAR(flt03_setup_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS setup_date, flt03_appr_id AS appr_id, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', appr.apr01_status_cd, appr.apr01_company_id, appr.apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_name, TO_CHAR(flt06_close_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS close_date, flt06_appr_id AS close_appr_id, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', closeAppr.apr01_status_cd, closeAppr.apr01_company_id, closeAppr.apr01_reg_date) AS close_appr_status_name FROM flt03_account INNER JOIN getPerson(#{companyId}, CAST(#{setupDate} AS date)) ON emp00_person_id = flt03_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id AND sys15_company_id = flt03_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr appr ON flt03_appr_id = appr.apr01_appr_id LEFT OUTER JOIN flt06_account_close ON flt06_account_id = flt03_account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr closeAppr ON flt06_appr_id = closeAppr.apr01_appr_id WHERE flt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt03_setup_date <= CAST(#{setupDate} AS date)
AND COALESCE(flt06_close_date, DATE '9999-12-31') >= CAST(#{setupDate} AS date)
ORDER BY emp00_org_code_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc, emp00_kor_nm, CASE WHEN flt03_main_account_yn = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt03_account (flt03_account_id, flt03_company_id, flt03_person_id, flt03_setup_date, flt03_reg_reason, flt03_family_relate_cd, flt03_main_account_yn, flt03_account_nm, flt03_account_no, flt03_corp_id, flt03_corp_branch_nm, flt03_item_type, flt03_note) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{req.setupDate}::date, #{req.regReason}, #{req.familyRelateCode}, CAST(#{req.mainAccountYn} AS varchar), #{req.accountName}, #{accountNo}, #{req.corpId}, #{req.corpBranchName}, #{req.itemType}, #{req.note})
mapper.update: UPDATE flt03_account SET flt03_setup_date = #{req.setupDate}::date, flt03_reg_reason = #{req.regReason}, flt03_family_relate_cd = #{req.familyRelateCode}, flt03_main_account_yn = CAST(#{req.mainAccountYn} AS varchar), flt03_account_nm = #{req.accountName}, flt03_account_no = #{accountNo}, flt03_corp_id = #{req.corpId}, flt03_corp_branch_nm = #{req.corpBranchName}, flt03_item_type = #{req.itemType}, flt03_note = #{req.note} WHERE flt03_account_id = #{req.accountId} AND flt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt03_person_id = #{personId}
mapper.select: SELECT flt06_account_close_id AS account_close_id, flt06_account_id AS account_id, TO_CHAR(flt06_close_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS close_date, f_cdnm('FamilyRelateCode', flt03_family_relate_cd, flt03_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS family_relate_name, flt03_account_nm AS account_name, TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no) AS account_no_dec, sys15_corp_nm AS corp_name, flt03_corp_branch_nm AS corp_branch_name, f_get_itemtype_nm(flt03_item_type, flt03_company_id) AS item_type_name, flt06_appr_id AS appr_id, TO_CHAR(apr01_reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS appr_reg_date, apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS appr_status_name FROM flt06_account_close INNER JOIN flt03_account ON flt03_account_id = flt06_account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON sys15_corp_id = flt03_corp_id AND sys15_company_id = flt03_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON flt06_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE flt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt03_person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY flt03_setup_date, sys15_corp_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc, TO_DECRYPTS(flt03_account_no)
SELECT count(*) FROM flt11_book WHERE flt11_account_id = #{accountId} AND flt11_book_date = #{closeDate}::date AND flt11_book_qty != 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flt06_account_close SELECT f_create_seq(), #{accountId}, #{closeDate}::date, NULL, NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM flt06_account_close WHERE flt06_account_close_id IN #{accountCloseId} AND flt06_account_id IN (SELECT flt03_account_id FROM flt03_account WHERE flt03_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt03_person_id = #{personId})
mapper.select: SELECT flt02_check_cycle FROM flt02_emp INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = flt02_person_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM flt01_company_std WHERE flt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt01_start_date <= f_today() AND flt01_rpt_start_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY flt01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) flt01 ON TRUE WHERE flt02_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt02_person_id = #{personId} AND flt02_start_date <= f_today() ORDER BY flt02_start_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT NULL AS check_cycle, apr01_status_cd AS oath_status_code, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, apr01_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS oath_status_name FROM flt04_oath LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON flt04_appr_id = apr01_appr_id WHERE flt04_company_id = #{companyId} AND flt04_person_id = #{personId} AND flt04_start_date <= f_today() ORDER BY flt04_start_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, f_class_tree_nm_allpath(a.dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name FROM dcr01_class_tree a, dcr30_link b WHERE dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND dcr30_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id AND dcr30_link_cd = #{linkCode} LIMIT 1
